item.title: Operation “Peer Review”: AI-assisted surveillance planning
item.description: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to draft surveillance-tool pitches, analyze documents, and debug code.

item.title: Romance-baiting scam: AI-assisted pig butchering workflows
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate and generate romance, investment scam conversations.

item.title: Operation “Sponsored Discontent”: Influence activity

item.description: OpenAI banned Rwanda-origin accounts using AI to generate partisan comments ahead of the country’s elections.

item.description: OpenAI banned Iran-origin STORM-2035 accounts using AI to generate US and UK election content and publish it across sites.

item.title: Operation “A2Z”: Multilingual influence activity
item.description: OpenAI banned “A2Z” accounts using AI to generate multilingual influence content about elections, Ukraine, and politics across platforms.

item.title: Operation “Stop News”: Russia-origin influence activity
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin “Stop News” accounts using AI to generate multilingual articles and posts targeting Ukraine and the West.

item.title: SweetSpecter: China-linked cyber activity

item.title: STORM-0817: Iran-linked malware and scraping activity
item.description: OpenAI banned Iran-linked STORM-0817 accounts using AI to debug Android malware, scrape social platforms, and translate tooling.

item.description: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Israel-origin operation we dubbed “Zero Zeno,” using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.

item.title: Operation "Doppelganger": Russian influence activity targeting Ukraine
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Russia-origin operation "Doppelganger", using AI to generate anti-Ukraine social media comments, translations, and website copy across several languages.

item.title: Operation "Spamouflage": China-linked influence activity
